competencies.performanceStandard: By the end of the term, learners carry out simple investigations and construct models to explain static electricity, electric circuits, and the properties of conductors and insulators, and apply their understanding to practical uses in the home and community. They observe, classify, and describe Earth materials, landforms, and changes caused by weathering, erosion, and the water cycle, and communicate ideas using diagrams, charts, and models. Learners explain weather disturbances in the Philippines and use models to describe the structure of the solar system and the motion of the Earth, Moon, and Sun.
